title: Readings imports
purpose: See the CSV files of temperature readings that were uploaded, whether each is ready to record, and open one.
summary: Find uploaded temperature-reading files, check their validation state and download a summary of the imports you selected.

tasks.title: Import readings
steps: As a technician, manager or administrator, select [[Upload readings]] and check your file.
Open the import and record its readings.

tasks.title: Find imports ready to record
steps: Set [[State]] to Ready to commit and select [[Apply]].

tasks.title: Download a register of imports
steps: Apply the file name search and [[State]] you want.
Select [[Export CSV]] to download every matching import in the current sort order.

good_to_know: Uploading only checks a file. Nothing is recorded until it is committed.
An uncommitted, valid import expires after 24 hours. The CSV shows the state at download time.
A file with any error cannot be committed.

sections.title: What the page shows
paragraphs: This is the Imports tab of Temperature readings. Each row is one uploaded and checked file: nothing is recorded from a file until a technician, manager or administrator commits it from its page. The file itself is not kept; the page keeps the checked rows, errors and warnings.
Every role that can sign in to the workspace can read this list, including viewers.

Choose 25, 50 or 100 rows per page. The initial size is 25. The register remembers your last accepted page size and sort. You can remove an active filter with its chip. Applying filters returns you to the first page.

sections.title: Search, filters and sorting
paragraphs: Search matches part of the file name. The default sort is Validated, newest first. Sortable columns are File, Rows and Validated.

items.label: State
items.description: Any state, Ready to commit (valid and not yet expired), Rejected (errors or no readings), Committed, or Expired (not committed within 24 hours).

items.label: File
items.description: The file name, or the validation time when there is none; opens the import.

items.label: State
items.description: Ready to commit, Rejected, Committed or Expired.

items.label: Rows
items.description: Number of reading rows that passed validation in this upload. A file with any errors still needs correction before you can commit it.

items.label: Errors
items.description: Problems found; a file with any error cannot be committed.

items.label: Equipment
items.description: The equipment chosen on the upload form, or Named in the file.

sections.title: Actions

items.label: Export CSV
items.description: Every workspace role, including viewers, can download the seven register columns for all matching imports in the applied sort order. Validation times include the repository time zone offset. A download records who exported the selection, its filters and sort, and how many rows it contained.

items.label: Upload readings
items.description: Technicians, managers and administrators. Opens the upload form.

paragraphs: A search with no matches downloads the column headings. Correct invalid filters to enable the download. If more than 10,000 imports match, the page shows the row limit. Narrow the selection to export. Open an individual import for its reading rows, warnings and error messages.

items.label: No imports yet
items.description: No file was uploaded. Technicians and above see an Upload readings button.
